title: Simon 6.2.25 and 6.2.30–6.2.32: the cone over a finite-mass compactly supported cycle, its boundary, its support and its form-level formula
statement: Let n, P ∈ ℕ and let S ∈ 𝒟_{n+1}(ℝ^P) (a GeometricCurrentOn univ (n + 1) on ℝ^P = Euclid P) have finite mass (S.mass ≠ ∞), compact support spt S (S.support) and ∂S = 0 (S.boundary = 0). Then there is R ∈ 𝒟_{n+2}(ℝ^P) (GeometricCurrentOn univ (n + 2)) such that spt R is compact, ∂R = S (R.boundary = S), and for every test (n+2)-form ω (TestFormOn univ (n + 2)) there is a test (n+1)-form γ (TestFormOn univ (n + 1)) with R(ω) = S(γ) and γ(x)(v_1, …, v_{n+1}) = ∫_0^1 t^{n+1} ω(tx)(x, v_1, …, v_{n+1}) dt for every x ∈ spt S and all v_1, …, v_{n+1} ∈ ℝ^P (here (x, v_1, …, v_{n+1}) is Fin.cons x v and the integral is the interval integral over [0, 1]). (R is Simon's cone 0 ⨯ S = h_#([[(0,1)]] × S), h(t, x) = tx, written as R(ω) = S(ζ·K_{n+2}ω) with the Poincaré homotopy operator K and a smooth cutoff ζ ≡ 1 near spt S.)
lean_statement: ∀ (n P : ℕ) (S : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (n + 1)), S.mass ≠ ∞ → IsCompact S.support → S.boundary = 0 → ∃ R : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (n + 2), IsCompact R.support ∧ R.boundary = S ∧ ∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (n + 2), ∃ γ : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (n + 1), R ω = S γ ∧ ∀ x ∈ S.support, ∀ v : Fin (n + 1) → Euclid P, (γ : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (n + 1)) x v = ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, t ^ (n + 1) * (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (n + 2)) (t • x) (Fin.cons x v)
